### `trace analysis`

Implementation: `packages/profiler-cli/src/resources/trace/actions/analysis.ts`.

- `counter` requires `--session`, `--package`, and `--name`, and returns process counter samples.
- `counter.spatialLoads` requires `--session` and `--frame-id`, accepts optional `--package`, and returns default spatial load counter statistics for the target spatial frame. Without `--package`, it only returns Spatial Runtime counters; with `--package`, it returns Runtime and App counters.
- `frame.appjanks` requires `--session` and `--package`, and accepts `--fps` for frame budget calculation.
- `frame.appSlowest` requires `--session` and `--package`, accepts `--fps` and `--limit`, and returns the slowest app frames ordered by duration.
- `frame.appBusyRunnings` requires `--session` and `--package`, accepts `--fps` and `--limit`, and returns app jank frames whose main-thread `Running` state exceeds the frame budget, ordered by frame duration.
- `frame.appOverview` requires `--session` and `--package`, accepts `--fps` for jank budget calculation, and returns app frame duration buckets, duration statistics, and per-time-bucket jank ratios with average / percentile / max bucket duration.
- `frame.spatialjanks` requires `--session`.
- `frame.spatialSlowest` requires `--session`, accepts `--limit`, and returns the slowest spatial frames ordered by duration.
- `frame.spatialOverview` requires `--session` and returns frame type statistics, frame duration buckets, abnormal frame duration statistics, and CPU/GPU stage duration buckets plus total, average, max, p50, p90, p95, and p99 duration statistics.
- `report.overview` requires `--session` and generates a self-contained HTML overview report. It always includes `frame.spatialOverview`; it includes `frame.appOverview` when `--package` is provided, includes `counter.spatialLoads` when `--frame-id` is provided, and includes `counter` when both `--package` and `--name` are provided. `--fps` is used for the app frame overview queries in this report.
- `counter`, `counter.spatialLoads`, `frame.appjanks`, `frame.spatialjanks`, `frame.appSlowest`, `frame.appBusyRunnings`, and `frame.spatialSlowest` return the same data shape as `trace query`: `{ sessionId, rpcEndpoint, rows }`.
- `frame.appOverview` returns `{ sessionId, rpcEndpoint, overview }`.
- `frame.spatialOverview` returns `{ sessionId, rpcEndpoint, overview }`.
- `report.overview` returns a compact execution result: `{ sessionId, rpcEndpoint, reportPath, reportType, executedAnalyses }`. The detailed analysis data is written into the HTML report, not printed to stdout.
- `frame.appOverview` jank timeline buckets are sized automatically from trace duration: `<30s => 1s`, `[30,60)s => 2s`, then one more second per additional 30 seconds. Timeline rows include `bucket_start_s`, `bucket_end_s`, `bucket_size_s`, `frame_count`, `jank_frame_count`, `avg_dur_ms`, `max_dur_ms`, `p50_dur_ms`, `p90_dur_ms`, `p95_dur_ms`, `p99_dur_ms`, and `jank_ratio`; duration statistics are rounded to three decimal places, and `jank_ratio` is formatted as a percentage string
